# MP attack dogs: T5 parity, measured (2026-10-23)

Scope: the multiplayer attack-dogs killstreak (`dogs_mp`) against Black Ops 1
(T5) multiplayer, by the same measure-T5-and-match method as the zm hounds
(docs/ZOMBIE_DOGS_T5_PARITY.md).

References: T5 GSC `D:\CoD\COD-GSC-Source\T5-STEAM-GSC\maps\mp\_dogs.gsc`,
`maps\mp\animscripts\dog_*.gsc`, `maps\mp\gametypes\_globallogic_player.gsc`;
T5 engine `D:\CoD\OpenBLOPS\Game\Server\game\actor_dog_exposed.cpp`,
`actor_threat.cpp`, `actor_events.cpp`, `sentient.cpp`,
`game_mp\g_main_mp.cpp` (dvar defaults), `Shared\bgame\bg_dog_animations_mp.cpp`.
CoDOL: `bin/home/codol_rawfiles/maps/mp/_dogs.gsc`, `maps/mp/animscripts/dog_*.gsc`,
`src/online/player/actor_lifecycle.cpp`, `dog_combat.c`,
`dog_states.cpp`, `ol_bot.c`.

## Method

The same capture body runs in both games:

- T5: `tools/t5cap/zz_t5mpdogcap.gsc` installed as
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Plutonium\storage\t5\scripts\mp\` (removed again after the
  runs), Plutonium t5mp windowed, `-lan`, `g_gametype tdm`, `devmap mp_nuked`.
  T5 MP has no `getanimtime`, so the T5 platform block reads the dog's
  animscript states by detouring the T5 dog animscripts (`replacefunc`).
- CoDOL: `maps/mp/_codol_dogcap.gsc` (generated by
  `tools/t5cap/mk_mpdogs.py`), started from `_dogs::init`, idle unless
  `dc_scn` is set; the CoDOL dog animscripts report the same states through
  `dog_shared::dogcap`. Probe: own exe copy, own `fs_homepath`, udp/17787,
  `developer 1`, `scr_bots 0`, `g_gametype war`, mp_nuked.
- Report: `python tools/mpdogcap_compare.py <log>...`.

mp_nuked is in both games with the same 34 TDM spawn points; its authored dog
spawn and exit nodes differ (C1 moved them inwards, e.g. T5 -2398,873 / C1
-1566,1049), so spawn and exit distances are map data, not behaviour.

Every run: the target player (allies, invulnerable, frozen at 693,-198) and a
frozen dog owner (axis test client) that calls the dogs 20 s in. Scenarios:
`frozen` (100 s), `move` (the target walks -1200,300 <-> 900,250 at 190 u/s,
3 runs each side), `kill` (each dog is killed by the target 4 s after it
spawns, rotating front/left/back/right), `hide` (the target is ignored:
pure patrol and leaving), `victims` (target ignored, three mortal allies bots
that fight: in T5 its test clients get the T5 bot AI, on CoDOL
`enableCombatBot`).

Before = live exe of 2026-10-23 04:59 (= origin/main 040f181a) with
rawfiles 52e2e26's capture; after = server ac16058c.

## What changed

Native (`src/online/player/actor_lifecycle.cpp`, server 6f87d62a):

- **ai_maxAttackerCount 2** (T5 `Actor_ShouldIgnoreFromAttackerCount`): a
  player two other actors already have as their enemy is not a new dog's
  target.
- **T5 awareness events** instead of sharing every sighting with the whole
  pack at once: sight; a packmate's new enemy within `ai_eventDistNewEnemy`
  1024, a second after it took it (`iEnemyNotifyTime`); its pain (512, also
  "attacked me") and death (1024) at a player's hands; the player's
  footsteps (512, 256 walking; none ducked/prone or with `specialty_quieter`);
  his gunshots (2048, 128 silenced; hooked in `NotifyWeaponFired`).
  Never-known players are not targets.
- **T5 threat score** (visible 1000 / aware 500, distance, -150 per attacker,
  current-enemy bonus, recently seen or attacked first); losing the enemy
  notifies `enemy`, which restarts `dog_patrol_when_no_enemy`.
- **Rate 1** for every MP dog state (T5 `bg_dog_animations_mp.cpp`
  `s_animRate` 1.0; `animplaybackrate` drives nothing).
- **Arrival frame keeps the move script** (T5 decides move/stop on the path it
  had when the think began; `dog_patrol` sets the next node before the next
  think).
- `ActorBotTargets` and `ol_bot.c` acquire (server ac16058c): bots
  take hostile dogs as targets by the same FOV and sight test.

GSC (rawfiles 52e2e26): the capture and the state hooks only; the dog GSC was
already a line-for-line T5 port (spawn waves, 60 s, regen, patrol, leaving,
spawn influencer, flash, actor damage/kill callbacks, dogkill XP).

## Clip mapping (C1's names are the source of truth)

C1's MP dog tree (`animtrees/dog.atr`, common_mp) is IW4's, 37
`german_shepherd_*` clips; T5's MP tree adds `german_shepard_*` turns, pains,
deaths and the low run attack. Bound by name in `dog_states.cpp`
(unchanged, checked: `coop_anim_check.py --category mp --map mp_nuked
--tree dog`: server and client trees identical, 57 entries):

| T5 state | T5 clip | C1 clip |
|---|---|---|
| move_run, lean | german_shepherd_run, run_lean_L/R | same |
| move_start / move_stop | run_start / run_stop | same |
| move_turn_left/right, run_turn_left/right | german_shepard_turn_90_*, run_turn_90_* | run_start_L / run_start_R |
| turn_around_*, run_turn_around_* | german_shepard_run_turn_180_*, run_start_180_* | run_start_180_L / _R |
| pain_* / pain_run_* | german_shepard_pain_hit_* / run_pain_hit_front | run_pain |
| death_front/back/left/right | death_front, german_shepard_death_hit_* | death_front |
| combat_attack_run | run_attack | same |
| combat_attack_player_close_range | german_shepard_run_attack_low | attack_player |
| combat_attack_miss(_left/_right) | attack_player_miss(_turnL/_turnR) | same |
| combat/stop attackidle(_bark/_growl) | attackidle* | same |
| flashed | run_flashbang | same |
| traverse_jump_down_80 | traverse_down_80 | traverse_down_40 |

The T5-only clips exist in C1 only as `zombie_dog_*` in the zm zones, which
the MP dog model's tree does not load; adding them server-side would shift
the client's tree.

## Not matched, and why

- **Directional pain and death, in-place turns**: C1's MP tree has one pain,
  one death and run-start turns only (above).
- **Bite damage attribution**: T5's `Callback_PlayerDamage` turns the dog into
  its owner (`figureOutAttacker`) before anything else, so the victim's
  damage/attackers list names the owner; CoDOL credits kills to the owner
  (+100 score each, as T5) but the damage callback still sees the dog. Left:
  it changes the shared damage pipeline (killcam, assists) for no kill
  difference.
- **Wall hops**: CoDOL dogs route on the bot waypoint graph and hop links over
  low walls (3-13 hops a minute on mp_nuked); T5's dogs path on dog nodes and
  never hopped in these runs.
- **Turn count**: 38-57 turns a minute (4 dogs) against T5's 21-39; the
  waypoint graph's routes bend more than T5's pathnode routes.
- **Moving target bites** are noisy (2 dogs, 60 s): T5 52% landed, after
  50% over three runs each; attack start distances match (108-129).
- **Barks** are T5 client script (`clientscripts/mp/_dogs.csc`); CoDOL plays
  the same state machine from the server (C1 runs no client script). No T5
  audio was captured.
- **Leaving time** differs only by the map's exit nodes.
- **Footsteps** run per frame for a moving grounded player (T5: per footstep
  event, every step); not separately measured.
